state.summary: Final selected target: atomic ProgramRolloverExecutionClaimed state pins approved version/content hash/approval member-role-time, command ID and claim time; blocks revision/rejection. Durable private process root starts on claim. A person authors full TypeIIPlanContent; process checks source validation and exhaustive mapping of all rollover records/commitments; changes_requested loops through revised version and remapping; reject terminates failed. Independent review then distinct CEO/CISO approval. Exact approved current plan precedes StartTypeIIObservationPeriod. TypeIIPeriodOpeningAccepted stays pending; exact ObservationPeriodStarted native chain including opening intent, plan proofs/hash, range, calendar auth/generation and operation result is terminal. No ProgramNextPeriodCreated emission. Process recovers exact target writes and persists before checkpoint.
state.reviewQuestion: The boundary verdict still split. Identify the single most material remaining missing rule, if any, from the choices; distinguish a true invariant gap from residual low confidence.

gap.instructions: What is the strongest remaining completeness objection to this selected rollover boundary?

criteria.claim_transition: Aggregate transition schema does not fully express expected-revision/idempotent claim or valid claimed state.
criteria.plan_correlation: Process does not prove the complete human-authored plan and mapping belong to this exact rollover/next plan identity.
criteria.plan_revision: changes_requested/revision loop can silently substitute another plan version or invalid mapping.
criteria.terminal_chain: ObservationPeriodStarted is not tied through actual accepted opening and calendar operation proof to exact claim.
criteria.failure_recovery: Failure/rejection leaves execution permanently claimed with no safe product recovery route.
criteria.duplicate_source_rollover: No cross-rollover uniqueness rule prevents multiple rollover IDs for same closed source period.
criteria.no_concrete_gap: The explicit state, owner flows and terminal proof cover these invariants; residual uncertainty is not a concrete omitted rule.
criteria.other_business_policy: A product policy not present in the supplied source is required.

correlation.instructions: Does the process bind the exact plan proposal/revisions/mapping to the claimed rollover ID and frozen NextTypeIIPlanId rather than merely accepting a matching plan event?

recovery.instructions: Does a failed plan/period process need to release or undo the execution claim?

criteria.permanent_fence: No. The durable process retries transient outages and terminal rejection/failure is not completion; releasing would reopen the approved version race. Any new business attempt is a separate proposal/decision.
criteria.release_required: Yes. Failure must restore editable approved status on the same aggregate.
